    • DRAW_CATEGORY_SECTOR_PARAMETERED_AUTOSHAPE

      public static final int DRAW_CATEGORY_SECTOR_PARAMETERED_AUTOSHAPE
      Requires 2 AM values and 2 AN values per sector. The first sector can have just one AM value although it is recommended to always use 2 values for each sector. X values are not required as our rendering is only 2D for the Sector Range Fan symbol. See ModifiersTG.java for modifier descriptions and constant key strings.
